source.title: Open Problems in Affine Algebraic Geometry: Problems for Problem Session

accepted.question_text: Let k be an algebraically closed field of characteristic 0, let n be an integer greater than 1, and let k[n] = k[x1, ..., xn] be the polynomial algebra in n variables. Let Aut*_k k[n] be the subgroup of polynomial k-automorphisms sigma of k[n] whose Jacobian determinant det(D_i(sigma(x_j))) is 1, where D_i = partial/partial x_i. Let T be the diagonal torus of volume-preserving automorphisms sigma = diag(t1, ..., tn) such that sigma(x_i) = t_i x_i and t1 ... tn = 1. A nonzero locally nilpotent derivation D of k[n] is a root vector of Aut*_k k[n] with respect to T when there is a nontrivial character chi: T -> G_m such that sigma o D o sigma^(-1) = chi(sigma)D for every sigma in T; chi is the corresponding root. What are all roots and all root vectors of Aut*_k k[n] with respect to T?
accepted.context_brief: Roots of the affine Cremona group

evidence.quote: Let k be an algebraically closed field of characteristic 0.
Let k[n] := k[x1, . . . , xn] be the polynomial algebra in variables x1, . . . , xn over k, and let n > 1.
Aut*_k k[n] := {sigma in Aut_k k[n] | det(Di(sigma(xj)))_{1<=i,j<=n} = 1}
T := {sigma := diag(t1, . . . , tn) in Aut*_k k[n] | sigma(xi) = tixi, ti in k, product_i ti = 1}.
Problem 1.1. Find all roots and root vectors of Aut*_k k[n] with respect to T.

accepted.question_text: Let k be an algebraically closed field of characteristic 0, let n > 1, and let k[n] = k[x1, ..., xn]. Let Aut*_k k[n] be the group of polynomial k-automorphisms with Jacobian determinant 1, and let T be the diagonal torus in Aut*_k k[n] consisting of automorphisms sigma = diag(t1, ..., tn) with sigma(x_i) = t_i x_i and t1 ... tn = 1. What are the centralizer and the normalizer of T inside Aut*_k k[n]?
accepted.context_brief: Diagonal torus in volume-preserving polynomial automorphisms

evidence.quote: Let k be an algebraically closed field of characteristic 0.
T := {sigma := diag(t1, . . . , tn) in Aut*_k k[n] | sigma(xi) = tixi, ti in k, product_i ti = 1}.
Problem 1.2. Describe the centralizer and the normalizer of T in Aut*_k k[n].

accepted.question_text: Let k be an algebraically closed field of characteristic 0, let n > 1, and let Aut*_k k[n] be the group of volume-preserving polynomial k-automorphisms of affine n-space, meaning automorphisms of k[x1, ..., xn] with Jacobian determinant 1. Is every algebraic torus action on affine n-space that lies in Aut*_k k[n] linearizable? Equivalently, does Aut*_k k[n] have no maximal algebraic tori of dimension less than n - 1?

evidence.quote: The question whether Aut*_k k[n] has no maximal (with respect to inclusion) algebraic tori of dimension < n - 1 is equivalent to asking whether every 'volume preserving' algebraic torus action on A^n is linearizable.
The first nontrivial case is n = 3.

accepted.question_text: Let k be an algebraically closed field of characteristic 0, let n > 1, and let Aut*_k k[n] be the group of polynomial k-automorphisms of k[x1, ..., xn] with Jacobian determinant 1. For a subgroup G of Aut*_k k[n], say that G is generated by locally nilpotent derivation exponentials if some set of locally nilpotent derivations of k[n] generates G through elements exp D. Say that G is finitely generated in the stronger source sense if a finite set of locally nilpotent derivations D generates G through all elements exp(fD) with f in Ker D. Is Aut*_k k[n] generated by locally nilpotent derivation exponentials, and if so, is it finitely generated in this stronger sense?
accepted.context_brief: Generation of volume-preserving polynomial automorphism groups

evidence.quote: A subgroup G of Aut*_k k[n] is called ∂-generated if there exists a set G of locally nilpotent derivations of k[n] such that G is generated by the elements exp D, where D in G.

A subgroup G of Aut*_k k[n] is called finitely ∂-generated if there exists a finite set G of locally nilpotent derivations of k[n] such that G is generated by the elements exp fD where D in G and f in Ker D.
Problem 2.1. Is the group Aut*_k k[n] ∂-generated? If yes, is it finitely ∂-generated?

accepted.question_text: Let k be an algebraically closed field of characteristic 0, let n > 1, and let k[n] = k[x1, ..., xn]. Given two locally nilpotent derivations P and Q of k[n], when is the smallest closed subgroup of Aut_k k[n] that contains the one-parameter subgroups {exp(tP) | t in k} and {exp(tQ) | t in k} finite-dimensional?

evidence.quote: Let P and Q be locally nilpotent derivations of k[n].
Problem 3.1. When is the minimal closed subgroup of Aut_k k[n] containing the one-dimensional subgroups {exp tP | t in k} and {exp tQ | t in k} finite dimensional?

accepted.question_text: Let k be an algebraically closed field of characteristic 0. Let G be a connected semisimple algebraic group over k, and let sigma be a finite-order automorphism of G. Define the fixed-point subgroup G^sigma = {g in G | sigma(g) = g}. Is the homogeneous algebraic variety G/G^sigma rational?

evidence.quote: Let G be a connected semisimple algebraic group over k, and let sigma in Aut_k G be an element of finite order.
Consider the subgroup G^sigma := {g in G | sigma(g) = g}.
Conjecture 4.1. The algebraic variety G/G^sigma is rational.
